column1: # github components: kind  name  key  description  flags (see lib/components.sh)
# Searches run on enter (a new query), not as you type: GitHub allows 30 searches a minute, 10 for code.
# mine and starred are lists fzf filters, so entering or leaving them restarts fzf.
# Ids are github.com URLs, so every action works on any row: a repository, a file or a directory.
mode  repos    -  search repositories (GitHub qualifiers in the query: language:go stars:>100)  default
mode  code     -  search code (qualifiers: repo:o/r language:sh filename:x path:y)              -
mode  mine     -  your repositories (--owner NAME: someone else's), last pushed first          restart
mode  starred  -  the repositories you starred, last starred first                             restart
mode  tree     -  the files of a repository (--repo OWNER/REPO [--ref REF])                     hidden
toggle  private  alt-1  private repositories only (with public: both)                          -
toggle  public   alt-2  public repositories only (with private: both)                          -
toggle  sources  alt-3  repositories that are not forks (with forks: both)                     -
toggle  forks    alt-4  forks only (with sources: both)                                        -
toggle  missing  alt-5  only repositories not cloned here yet (cloned ones are marked)        -
action  browser   alt-o   open in the browser                                                    silent
action  clone     alt-c   clone the repositories with ghq (yours over ssh) and link them (FZX_REPOS_LINKS_DIR)  foreground
action  fetch     alt-d   repos, mine, starred: clone; code, tree: download the selected files and directories  foreground
action  edit      ctrl-e  code, tree: open the file in $EDITOR (a read-only copy)                 foreground
action  star      alt-s   repos, code, mine: star the repositories; starred: unstar them          foreground,reload
action  fork      alt-F   fork the repository to your account (no clone)                         foreground,confirm
action  settings  alt-e   open the repository's settings page in the browser                     silent
action  web       alt-w   repos, code: open the search on github.com                             silent
action  copy      ctrl-y  copy the urls                                                          silent,builtin
